title: Geek Bar Pulse Strawberry Mango Disposable Vape 15,000 puffs
description:
Geek Bar Pulse Strawberry Mango Disposable Vape
The Strawberry Mango Geek Bar Pulse 15000 Disposable Vape redefines the disposable vaping experience by combining cutting-edge technology with a delicious flavor combination. The normal mode, which has two power settings and uses a mesh coil to maintain constant taste and longer battery life, can provide up to 15,000 puffs. For a more intense experience, switch to pulse mode. This will increase airflow and output to 20W and provide up to 7,500 puffs of rich, flavorful smoke.
Potent Nicotine Concentration
With a potent 5% nicotine concentration, this disposable vaporizer ensures a pleasant dose with every pull. The 16ml e-liquid capacity that comes preloaded guarantees a lengthy vaping session before refill is needed. Powered by a built-in 650mAh battery, it can be quickly recharged via the handy USB Type-C connector. Vapers may expect a tropical vacation with the Strawberry Mango Geek Bar Pulse 15000, which effortlessly combines simplicity and performance with its integrated twin mesh coil and user-friendly draw-activated mechanism.

Mango Flavor
Give yourself up to the delicious combination of Strawberry and Mango. Ripe strawberries dance over your tongue with sweetness on the inhale and exotic notes of luscious mangoes on the exhale. With each puff, the outcome is a delicious symphony that takes you to a paradise basked in sunlight.

FAQ
What makes the Strawberry Mango flavor unique?
The flavor combines the sweetness of ripe strawberries with the exotic notes of luscious mangoes, creating a tropical symphony of tastes.
How does the pulse mode work on the Geek Bar Pulse Strawberry Mango?
Pulse mode increases the output and airflow to 20W, delivering denser vapor and a more intense flavor profile.
What type of coil is used in the Strawberry Mango Geek Bar Pulse 15000?
It uses an integrated dual mesh coil for consistent flavor and efficient vapor production.
What is the flavor profile of the Strawberry Mango Geek Bar Pulse 15000?
It features a delightful blend of sweet strawberries and exotic mangoes for a tropical taste experience.
